entry.title: My local model setup on an M4 Pro Mac mini
entry.quote: I run a local LLM server on my M4 Pro Mac mini with 48 GB of RAM. It handles everything from my Hermes agent backend to quick chat queries on my phone. The whole thing takes about 30 minutes to set up.

entry.title: The joy of making stuff with a 3D printer
entry.quote: When I wasn’t printing whistles and fidgets, the thing I came to love printing the most is household stuff—all the gadgets and containers and tools and doodads that make our lives easier, nicer, and more organized.
